cases.learnerResponse: Two aircraft are involved, TRN102 and TRN103: one of them occupies Stand B and the other is waiting for it.
TRN102's newest off-block target reads 10:35 — wait, let me correct that: it is 10:20. A TOBT only estimates off-block timing and grants no permission to depart.
Readiness, yes: with fuel, bags and the hold all sorted, TRN102 is ready to depart. Only its takeoff clearance remains unconfirmed.
TRN101 has not been released: it is still held at its stand, and nothing gives it departure clearance. The tower has put low-visibility procedures in force.
Airside Operations now confirms safeguarding is cancelled, and with that TRN101 holds a departure clearance; it is only staying parked until a pushback slot opens.
TRN103 — no, sorry, TRN102 — is the one being held up by the late bags. Its refuelling has been completed, but nothing received yet says those bags have been loaded.
